reason: Registers happy-dom Window globals onto globalThis for Bun unit tests that render React.
maintenance: Pinned with happy-dom 20.11.2 as the official companion registrator; upgrades stay paired with that runtime.
provenance: Published by the happy-dom maintainers and resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: A hand-rolled Window polyfill would miss layout, events, and observer APIs that components already assume.
